title: Add OVER/XOVER streaming: don't buffer full range in memory
description:
The OVER [range] command currently (or will) query all overview records into a Vec and then write them. For large ranges this is unbounded memory. Change to streaming: query SQLite with a cursor (LIMIT/OFFSET or keyset pagination) and write each line to the client as it arrives. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/over.rs refactored for streaming.

Acceptance: OVER 1-100000 does not allocate a Vec of 100000 entries; memory usage remains bounded regardless of range size; response is identical to the buffered version for small ranges
